Raja Bandhan Urf Rajpal S/o Ram Lal Bandhan Aged About 30 Years
R/o Bapunagar, Police Station Kotwali, District- Raigarh, Chhattisgarh.

---- Applicant
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh
Through Station House Officer, Police Station City
Kotwali Raigarh, District- Raigarh, Chhattisgarh.

---- Respondent
For Applicant : Shri Prabhat Kumar Saxena, Advocate For State : Shri Roshan Dubey, P.L Hon'ble

Shri Justice Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal Order On Board 19/09/2023
1.

The present bail application has been filed u/s 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the
applicant who has been arrested in connection with Crime No.1475/2022 registered at Police
Station City Kotwali Raigarh, District- Raigarh (Cg) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 &
506 of Ipc and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2.  As per the prosecution case, the mother of the victim lodged a report to the concerned PS alleging that on 01.11.2022 the applicant committed forcibly sexual intercourse with the victim who is a mentally unsound minor girl.
On report being lodged to the above effect, offence under the aforesaid sections have been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
He submits that under the pressure of family members a false report has been lodged against the applicant.

He further submits that the applicant is in jail since 03.11.2022 and there is no likelihood of the trial to be concluded at the earliest, therefore, prays for the applicant to be released on bail.
4.
State counsel, on the other hand, opposing the bail application submits that considering the nature of offence, the applicant does not deserve to be released on bail.

5. The mother of victim appeared before this Court through Video Conferencing from the concerned DLSA today and objected in granting bail to the applicant.
6.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

entities.text: Raja Bandhan Urf Rajpal vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 7. Taking into consideration the entire facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the age of victim/prosecutrix who at the time of incident is said to be around 14 years and also the fact that she is a mentally challenged girl, the mother of victim has objected in granting bail to the applicant and also considering the gravity and nature of offence, this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the application for grant of bail stands rejected.

Sd/- 
(Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal) JUDGE Khatai Raja Bandhan Urf Rajpal vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20837196/
